scale_bins.excluded_pixels: GT component pixels from other scales
scale_bins.positive_pixels: pixels from GT components in the requested scale

threshold_free_defect_attribution.tie_policy: top-area masks include every pixel with score greater than or equal to the cutoff score; boundary ties may exceed the nominal area budget and are reported by selected counts and observed selected area fraction

normalization_contract.attention_fusion: per-layer L2 normalized head-concatenated facets, concatenated across layers with 1/sqrt(num_layers) scale
normalization_contract.calibration_source: fixed support-16 only; no test_public or GT used
normalization_contract.equal_ensemble: member score maps are standardized with fixed-support leave-one-out mean/std, then averaged equally
normalization_contract.patch_descriptor: L2 normalize each patch descriptor per selected layer before fusion
normalization_contract.qquery_ksupport: query uses normalized Q post-RoPE descriptors; support memory uses normalized K post-RoPE descriptors
